items.title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generat
items.summary_zh: 提出小模型微调方法解决 RAG 中的查询澄清问题，在多轮对话中优化模糊查询，提升检索精度。
items.why_zh: 涉及 RAG 系统优化与 Few-shot 微调策略，学习如何在小模型上实现高效的对话上下文理解与检索增强。

items.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
items.summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and forma
items.summary_zh: 发布 IQuest-Q1，一款 320B 稀疏 MoE 代理基础模型，采用三阶段预训练，增强 CLI 代理能力。
items.why_zh: 关注大规模 MoE 架构与代理（Agentic）模型训练细节，可借鉴其稳定性技巧与代码数据混合策略。

items.title: Folkbench/folkbench
items.summary: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex
items.summary_zh: 开源 Rust 工具 Folkbench，提供 AI API 中转站评测排行与切换功能，实测 Claude Code 等兼容性。
items.why_zh: 涉及 LLM 基础设施开发与性能基准测试，学习如何构建多 API 路由代理及监控可用性与延迟。

items.title: ollaya-dev/ollaya
items.summary: Jev-compatible API server for open decision models. Ollama for decision models: pull and serve 24 model families (Laya, pplx-decider, Clef, Winnow, Kev...) locally or self-hosted behind /v1/systemone. TypeSafe SDK works by changing one env var. CLI, daemon, desktop app, Docker, MCP server, public bench.
items.summary_zh: Ollaya 是兼容 Jev API 的本地服务器，支持 24 种决策模型家族，提供 CLI、MCP 服务器及 Docker 部署。
items.why_zh: 涉及本地模型推理服务架构，学习如何封装不同模型为统一 API，并集成 MCP 协议与类型安全 SDK。

items.title: h9-tec/ai-roadmap-2026
items.summary: AI Roadmap 2026: a beginner's path through Foundations, LLM Engineering, Agents, Evaluation, and Production, with verified free resources and a mini-project per layer
items.summary_zh: AI Roadmap 2026，为初学者提供从 LLM 工程到代理及生产的分层学习路径，含免费资源与迷你项目。
items.why_zh: 虽非技术库，但提供系统化的 Agent 工程化知识体系，有助于构建从基础到生产的完整技术栈认知。

items.title: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
items.summary_zh: OpenShell 项目提供安全私密的运行时环境，专为大规模自主 AI 代理集群设计，保障执行安全。
items.why_zh: 涉及 Agent 安全沙箱与隔离技术，学习如何为大规模自主代理构建可信执行环境及资源管控机制。

items.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
items.summary_zh: 文章指出 LLMs 正在让更大规模的正式软件验证变得可行，显著提升验证效率。
items.why_zh: 掌握形式化验证与 LLM 结合的前沿应用，了解如何用 AI 降低复杂系统验证门槛的技能。

items.title: Gathin23/cleanyourtv
items.summary: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
items.summary_zh: 开源项目 Gathin23/cleanyourtv 通过 Wi-Fi 去繁 Android 或 Google TV，实现 Apple TV 风格主页。
items.why_zh: 涉及 Android 系统定制与低代码开发实践，适合工程师学习移动端系统优化及 UI 重构的工程技巧。

items.title: The Boring Version of Continual Learning
items.summary: Will Brown of Prime Intellect makes the case that continual learning is about to get boring, in a good way: it is the software development life cycle, applied to models. He traces how agent workflows grow from terminal experiments into production software, why evals should capture the vibe check, and which post-training methods he reaches for, from SFT and on-policy and context distillation to online RL, along with why he is skeptical of jumping straight to OPSD. He closes on build versus buy fo…
items.summary_zh: Prime Intellect 的 Will Brown 主张将持续学习视为模型软件开发周期，涵盖 SFT、蒸馏及评估方法。
items.why_zh: 学习 AI 模型运维（MLOps）全生命周期管理，掌握后训练策略选择及评估体系构建的核心工程思维。

items.title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
items.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: TinyFish 解析生产级 Agentic 搜索架构，定义 7 阶段流程、证据契约及有界重试，优化深度研究系统。
items.why_zh: 深入理解 Agent 工作流设计、错误处理机制及证据驱动架构，提升构建高可靠性 AI 系统的工程能力。

items.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation News today from Anthropic: We’re committed to keeping Agent Skills open, community-driven, and vendor-neutral. Today, we are donating the standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation, which we co-founded with Block and OpenAI last year, and to which we donated the Model Context Protocol (MCP). I'm pleased to note I called this one last December , when Anthropic first declared skills to be an "open standard": I wouldn't…
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 将 Agent Skills 标准捐赠给 Linux 基金会旗下的 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)，确保其开放中立。
items.why_zh: 关注 AI 生态标准化进程，理解 MCP 与 Agent Skills 等协议在跨厂商协作中的治理与工程实现逻辑。

items.title: Uber rolls out ChatGPT Work to 30,000+ employees
items.summary: Following a 1,000-person pilot, Uber is bringing ChatGPT Work to more than 30,000 employees worldwide in its first company-wide deployment of an agentic platform for knowledge work. Uber CTO Praveen Neppalli Naga and OpenAI co-founder and President Greg Brockman discuss expanding AI beyond engineering and helping teams rethink entire workflows. Read more about Uber’s rollout of ChatGPT Work: https://openai.com/index/uber-chatgpt-work-rollout/
items.summary_zh: Uber 将 ChatGPT Work 部署给超 3 万名员工，成为首个大规模企业级 Agentic 知识工作平台。
items.why_zh: 研究大规模企业 AI 落地案例，学习如何将 Agentic 平台集成至非工程部门以重构工作流的知识管理方法。

items.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 通过多租户、全球缓存和 Azure Cosmos DB 扩展 Habitat，使 ChatGPT 读取速度提升 12 倍
items.why_zh: 属于大规模在线存储与多租户架构技能点，可复用全球缓存层设计和 Cosmos DB 分区策略

items.title: Messi asks ChatGPT to teach him a chess opening
items.summary: Messi asked ChatGPT to teach him a chess opening that matched his style. It suggested Goat Horns. 🐐🤘 Try ChatGPT's Intelligent UI yourself: “Based on what you know about me, teach me something new. Show me step by step."
items.summary_zh: 梅西让 ChatGPT 推荐符合风格的国际象棋开局，模型给出“羊角”并演示逐步教学
items.why_zh: 属于提示工程与个性化交互技能点，展示如何利用用户画像生成定制化分步教学提示
